description: This file defines an AuditService class responsible for recording and querying audit events within a system. It interacts with a database to insert audit logs, capturing details such as actor information, event types, timestamps, and results, following an append-only, immutable audit trail. The class provides methods for logging new events and retrieving past events, including filtering capabilities.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: A service class managing the creation and querying of audit events, ensuring transactional integrity and follow-up event traceability.

methods.description: Creates and records a new audit event in the database, returning the unique audit event ID. Captures actor, event, entity details, timestamp, and optional additional details.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of audit events from the database, optionally filtered by entity type and ID, limited to a specified number of records.
